scenes.heading: Query Editor
scenes.subheading: Write and run SQL in the browser
scenes.narration: The Databricks SQL query editor is a browser-based tool for writing SQL, running it on a warehouse, and visualizing the results.

scenes.heading: What it offers
scenes.narration: The editor offers autocomplete and a schema browser so you discover tables and columns as you type. Result sets can become charts with a single click. And you can save queries with parameters to reuse and share them across the team.

scenes.heading: A query in the editor
scenes.code:
SELECT region,
       SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM   samples.sales
WHERE  order_date >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP  BY region
ORDER  BY total_sales DESC;
scenes.narration: This query aggregates total sales by region for the current year. You pick a SQL warehouse, run it, and the grid of results appears instantly. From there you can turn the output into a bar chart or pin it to a dashboard.

scenes.text: Save and parameterize frequent queries so teammates can rerun them with different filters without rewriting SQL.
scenes.narration: Save and parameterize your frequent queries so teammates can rerun them with different filters without rewriting any SQL.
